subject: Next steps & rotating demo schedule — technical deep dive coordination
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@bluefincap.com>
Cc: rachel.kim@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & rotating demo schedule — technical deep dive coordination

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap of what I heard:
- Primary use case: customer support summarization and privacy-filtered search across contracts.
- Key constraints: sub-50ms p95 for routing decisions, SOC 2 evidence required, and expected steady load of ~8M tokens/month with peak spikes.
- Decision-makers: you (product), procurement (copied), and an infra SME who will join the technical deep dive.

Next step: technical deep dive + demo to validate latency numbers and discuss VPC/private deployment options. To make scheduling easier across your EU and APAC reviewers, we usually run on a rotating cadence so no single team bears late/early calls every week. Proposed rotation pattern (weekly rotate):

Option A — Week 1 (US-friendly)
- US morning: 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
- EU overlap: 18:00 CEST (late for EU)
- APAC: 02:00 SGT (overnight)

Option B — Week 2 (EU-friendly)
- EU morning: 10:00 CEST / 09:00 BST
- US: 04:00 PT (early)
- APAC: 18:00 SGT

Option C — Week 3 (APAC-friendly)
- APAC morning: 10:00 SGT / 11:00 JST
- EU: 03:00 CEST
- US: 20:00 PT

If you prefer fewer permutations, we can do a fixed alternating schedule (US-week / EU-week) instead. Attached is a simple timezone matrix I made showing equivalent local times for the three-week rotation.

Please reply with which week type you'd like for the first technical deep dive and two 60-minute windows that work for your team next two weeks. If easier, share a Calendly/Outlook link and we’ll grab a slot.

Agenda proposal (we can tweak):
1) 20m: short architecture walkthrough and topology options (Hosted, Dedicated, Private)
2) 25m: live latency/cost benchmarks with our standard prompt set
3) 15m: Q&A and mutual action items (SOC 2 evidence, account-level metrics)

I attached a one-page mutual action plan and the timezone matrix for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: timezone_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual_action_plan.pdf (PDF)

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@bluefincap.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@bluefincap.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Next steps & rotating demo schedule — technical deep dive coordination

Kimberly —

Thanks for the clear recap. That rotation idea makes sense and would solve our cross-region calendar pain. For the first session we prefer an EU-friendly slot so our infra lead can attend during working hours.

Two windows that work for us in the next 10 business days (CEST):
- Tue 1 Sep, 10:00 CEST (preferred)
- Thu 3 Sep, 14:00 CEST (backup)

Procurement asked for a ballpark of pricing bands ahead of the demo (hosted vs dedicated vs private) so they can start internal approvals — can you send a short summary or attach a price sheet? I’ll loop them into the demo invite once we confirm.

On the rotation pattern: EU-week first then US-week would be our preference if that helps.

Appreciate it,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Product, BlueFin Capital
oliver.grant@bluefincap.com
